function.name: calculate_svm
function.description: Calculate the Support Vector Machine(SVM) model

train_data.description: The training data for the SVM model. Should include the class labels.

test_data.description: The test data for the SVM model. This data will be used to verify the model.

C.description: The Regularization parameter. The strength of the regularization is inversely proportional to C. Must be strictly positive. Default is 1.0. This is a float type value.
